topic: Amatyakaraka — the Jaimini career significator and how to use it (DD deep-dive reel, English, 2026-09-08 pm)

slides.sub: The career significator that isn't a house, a lord, or a yoga

slides.body:
In the Jaimini stream, the planets are ranked by degree alone — ignore sign, ignore house, just take how far into its sign each planet has travelled.

Highest degree = Atmakaraka (AK, the soul significator). Second highest = Amatyakaraka (AmK, literally the minister). These are chara (variable) karakas — they change chart to chart, unlike the fixed significators.

Two counting schemes exist and they genuinely disagree. The seven-karaka scheme uses the visible planets only; the eight-karaka scheme adds Rahu, whose degree is counted backwards from 30° because it moves in reverse.

Adding Rahu can shift every karaka down a rank. Pick one scheme, know which you are using, and do not silently switch mid-reading.

The name is the instruction. If the Atmakaraka is what the soul is here to work out, the Amatyakaraka is the one who carries it out in the world — the counsellor, the executive function, the working life.

So AmK describes the nature of your work far more than its job title. A chart does not contain the word "architect". It contains a temperament that a career has to fit.

points: Which planet is AmK — its natural karakatva sets the flavour
Its sign and house in the D1 (the birth chart, always read first)
Its nakshatra — this is where the texture actually lives
Its placement in Dashamsha D10 (the career varga)
Its relationship to the AK — the two working together or pulling apart
And the dasha: an AmK period is when work questions get loud

slides.body:
AmK will not name a profession, and any reading that produces a confident job title from it is overreaching. It is one input among the 10th house, the 10th lord, D10, and the running dasha — not a replacement for them.

It is also, honestly, a technique that rewards patience. Ranked karakas look precise because they use degrees, but a chart with two planets a fraction of a degree apart will hand you a different AmK on a different ayanamsa.

Work it out — second-highest degree, ignoring sign — and comment it. It is a two-minute calculation and it reframes how you read your own 10th house.

Save this one; the ranking is easy to forget and easy to get backwards for Rahu.
